crossRefs.note: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and…
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits…
Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

translations.web: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.
translations.bsb: But if the unbeliever leaves, let him go. The believing brother or sister is not bound in such cases. God has called you to live in peace.
translations.kjv: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is ➔ not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us to peace.
translations.asv: Yet if the unbelieving departeth, let him depart: the brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us in peace.
